temporalDefinitions.traditional: Contact-era speaker areas in the Americas and Australia; Atlas-era contemporary areas are used as proxies elsewhere, as documented by Glottography v2.0.
temporalDefinitions.contemporary: Speaker areas digitized from the second edition of Asher and Moseley (2007); this is an Atlas-era layer, not a 2026 survey.

unlocatedRecords.note: These three L1 sign-language catalogue records have no Glottolog coordinates and therefore cannot be plotted; 219 of 222 are located.

transform.crosswalk: Every Glottography family ID must resolve to a Glottolog 5.3 genealogical lineage or an explicit excluded root; soma1242 is the sole retired ID and maps to Momuna momu1241.
transform.pointPolicy: Exactly one supplemental point is emitted for each lineage lacking polygons in both layers. It is the observed Glottolog member-language geodesic medoid (or sole located member), never an inferred territory; point lineage IDs and polygon lineage IDs are disjoint.

colourPolicy.method: Stable degree-first greedy colouring of a conservative five-degree component-envelope adjacency/overlap graph from both temporal layers.
colourPolicy.note: Envelope false positives only request extra colour separation. If twelve swatches are exhausted, the least-conflicting swatch is selected deterministically.
